all.title: File:Slate Fence - geograph.org.uk - 390027.jpg
all.author: Jonathan Wilkins
all.description: Slate Fence Poor-quality slates which would not cleave well enough for roofing were used for fencing. The ends were buried and the top secured with a braided wire. Durable until the wire rusted, these slate fences are a very local feature, and are being lost as time passes.
